item.title: Delta suspends special congressional desk service amid shutdown

item.title: Arkansas Rep. Stan Berry dead at 71
item.description: Arkansas Rep. Stan Berry, a 71-year-old Republican, passed away on January 9, 2023, after serving in the Arkansas legislature, the National Guard, and various other roles in the community.

item.title: Darius Acuff Jr. signs 'historic' shoe deal with Reebok: report
